notes: Compact store browsing and app details; correct Install, Update and Open states; explicit update queue with Android installation approval; original-colour social logos in swipeable header/footer rows; only verified today-IST public-post counts. Unknown device state is never treated as not installed. No fake ratings or download counts. Existing preview-and-Send forms use HTTPS via FormSubmit, not end-to-end encryption, as disclosed. No remote web installation or conditional silent updates in this release.
